resources.string: Please keep this window open while the language model is downloading.
Tap a language to download its model, tap again to make it active. Hold a downloaded model to delete it. Recognition runs on the device, the voice message is not sent anywhere.
Voice recognition runs through Cloudflare Workers AI, but the account ID and API token for it are empty. Fill them in, or pick another provider in Chats — offline Vosk needs no account at all.
Voice recognition runs through Gemini, but the API key for it is empty. Fill it in, or pick another provider in Chats — offline Vosk needs no account at all.
Voice recognition runs through an OpenAI-compatible API, but its address, model or key are empty. Fill them in, or pick another provider in Chats — offline Vosk needs no account at all.
Offline recognition has no language model yet. Download one and voice messages will be recognized on the device, without network or Premium.
